explication: Strimzi is a Kubernetes and OpenShift operator for running and managing Apache Kafka. The principal workflow is an administrator declaring Kafka configuration as custom resources; the cluster operator reconciles cluster resources, while topic and user operators separately manage Kafka topics and user credentials. The API models expose additional managed capabilities, including Connect, MirrorMaker 2, Bridge, and rebalancing. The tree and README establish these product areas, but most implementation excerpts were not sampled, so the graph omits uncertain internal call wiring.
